form.title: Add or update spend
form.description: One entry per day, optionally per source and per country — entering a day that already has spend updates it, it never stacks. A day is either one total or split by country, not both.

list.emptyDescription: Add a day's spend above to start tracking Profit/ROI/CPA on the Overview tab.
list.deleteConfirmDescription: This removes it from Profit/ROI/CPA calculations. This can't be undone.

timezoneNotice.title: Spend is daily in the ad account's time zone
timezoneNotice.description: {{zones}} reports spend per day in its own time zone, this report cuts clicks by {{timezone}}. A day's cost and that day's clicks are hours apart, so daily cost and ROI are approximate; totals over whole weeks or months are barely affected.

import.title: Import CSV
import.description: Columns: date (YYYY-MM-DD), amount, currency, and optionally country (2-letter code; empty = day total) and traffic_source_id. Rows overwrite the same day/country. The file is imported whole or not at all.
import.errorsTitle: Nothing was imported. Fix these rows and try again:
